The count data were normalized using “Relative Log Expression” normalization (RLE) implemented in the DESeq2 R package. Poor-quality transcriptome profiles were determined based on inter-sample correlation <0.7 and excluded from the subsequent analyses. | Genome_build: hg19 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: .gct file format (tab-delimited text) including normalized gene expression levels.
